references.text: The parallel passage in Exodus where the fifth commandment is first given. The command to honor father and mother with the promise of long life.
Repeats the command to honor father and mother in the Holiness Code.
A curse on anyone who despises their father or mother, showing the seriousness of breaking this commandment.
Proverbs encourage listening to a father's instruction and not rejecting a mother's teaching.
An exhortation to listen to one's father and not despise one's mother when she is old.
Jesus quotes the command to honor father and mother and criticizes the Pharisees for circumventing it through tradition.
Jesus mentions the command to honor father and mother as one of the commands to keep.
Jesus quotes the commandment and criticizes those who place traditions above God's word regarding honoring parents.
Jesus lists the command to honor father and mother among the important commandments.
Jesus mentions the command to honor father and mother in conversation with the rich young man.
Paul quotes this commandment directly and emphasizes that it is the first commandment with a promise attached to it.
Children are exhorted to obey their parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.
